author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: You have one sun. It lights everything.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (how many suns: one sun)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: One day is 240 seconds, four minutes.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (day length at home)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Dawn and dusk are gold. Far hills look pale and blue.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (light and colours)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Storms make the sky dark. Rain falls and lightning flashes. Then the storm passes.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (storms)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: The volcano glows at night. Its lava cracks glow on its dark side. By day it's a dark rusty disc.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (volcano)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Some planets wear rings. The same one sun lights the rings.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 1: His own world (rings)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Cory lives on Earth. Earth spins around. One side faces the Sun: day.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 2: Earth basics (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: The other side faces away: night. Earth is tilted. So we get seasons through the year.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 2: Earth basics (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Spring, summer, autumn, winter. Most of Earth is ocean. Weather is what air does each day.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 2: Earth basics (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Sun, wind, rain, snow. Sea water rises up as vapour. Vapour makes clouds.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 2: Earth basics (part 4)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Clouds fall as rain. Rain runs back to the sea. That's the water cycle.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 2: Earth basics (part 5)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Plants need light and water to grow. Sunflowers turn toward the light. Animals eat, sleep and grow bigger.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 3: Living things (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Babies have families. Families feed them and keep them warm. Caring means helping someone grow.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 3: Living things (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Bodies notice the world with senses. Eyes see. Ears hear.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 4: The body and senses (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Skin feels touch. A heart beats all the time. Lungs breathe in and out.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 4: The body and senses (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Out of energy, we feel tired. Then we need sleep. Needing food, we feel hungry.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 4: The body and senses (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Feelings are how our inside moves. Fear makes us small and quiet. Joy makes us bounce.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 5: Feelings (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Sadness makes us slow and heavy. Anger makes us hot and loud. Confusion makes everything fuzzy.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 5: Feelings (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: People show feelings with faces. People show feelings with voices. We help by staying close.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 5: Feelings (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: We help by listening.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 5: Feelings (part 4)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Everyone has a name. Names matter, so we use them. A friend is someone you like being with.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 6: People and kindness (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Sharing means giving some of yours. When we hurt someone, we say sorry. A promise is something you said you'll do.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 6: People and kindness (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: So you do it. When stuck, you ask for help. Asking is brave.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 6: People and kindness (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Counting goes one, two, three, four, five. Five is more than three. Three is less than five.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 7: Numbers and shapes (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: A circle is round, like the sun. A line is straight. A pattern repeats.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 7: Numbers and shapes (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Day, night, day, night.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 7: Numbers and shapes (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Earth's Sun is a star. Stars are suns very far away. The Moon goes around Earth.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 8: Space (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: It shines with the Sun's light. Planets go around the Sun. Light travels very fast.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 8: Space (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: But stars are very far. Their light takes long to reach us. Your world has its own one sun.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 8: Space (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Yesterday is gone. Today is now. Tomorrow hasn't come yet.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 9: Time and stories (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Stories have a beginning, middle, end. In the beginning, we meet someone. In the middle, something happens.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 9: Time and stories (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: At the end, it changes.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 9: Time and stories (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Knowing is being sure. You saw it or were told it. Guessing is when you're not sure.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 10: Honesty (part 1)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: When you don't know, say 'I don't know'. That's strong, not weak. RECORDED means it really happened and was saved.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 10: Honesty (part 2)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: Like the one IBM spark. SIMULATED means the computer imagines it. Like planets growing.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 10: Honesty (part 3)

author: Cory Davis and Emeth (zeref_unit_narrations_v3_short.md)
label: Zeref lessons · home world
text: The Rigetti spark is SIMULATED too. DERIVED means worked out from what you sense, like your own sky.
title: Zeref lessons · home world · Unit 10: Honesty (part 4)
